endpoints.name: Get All
endpoints.detailed_description: Retrieve all MPDS records. It calls ICommon.getUserByToken, IMPDS.GetMPDSData, IMPDS.GetMPDSActions. Data access uses stored procedure(s): GetMPDSList, GetSectionActions. Possible responses: 200, 401, 500.

ai_agent_guidance.do_not_use_when: When the user only wants to change data

business_logic.depends_on_user_context: Resolves the current user from the JWT (getUserByToken / claims)

endpoints.name: Create Data

idempotency.notes: Not idempotent; repeating the call may perform the action again

endpoints.detailed_description: Create data. It validates the request, then calls ICommon.getUserByToken, ICommon.GetUserById, IMPDS.GetFinancialYearByIdAsync. Persists changes to: MPDSHeader: INSERT. Possible responses: 200, 400, 401, 404, 500.

error_handling.validation_errors: 400: Valid User ID is required. [when request.UserId <= 0]; Valid Financial Year ID is required. [when request.YearId <= 0]; Selected financial year was not found. [when financialYear == null]
error_handling.not_found: 404: User not found. [when selectedUser == null]; MPDS record not found. [when mpdsHeader == null]
error_handling.unauthorized: 401/403: Unauthorized: Invalid or missing token. [when currentUser == null]; Invalid token or user not found [when currentUser == null]

ai_agent_guidance.use_when: When the user wants to create data
ai_agent_guidance.do_not_use_when: When the user only wants to view data, or the required inputs are not available yet

business_logic.preconditions: Valid Bearer JWT; request body of type CreateMPDSDto; passes 5 validation/business rule check(s) (see validation_rules)
business_logic.validations: Valid User ID is required.; Valid Financial Year ID is required.; Selected financial year was not found.

endpoints.name: Update Data

error_handling.validation_errors: 400: Valid User ID is required. [when request.UserId <= 0]; Valid Financial Year ID is required. [when request.YearId <= 0]
error_handling.not_found: 404: MPDS record not found. [when mpdsHeader == null]; User not found. [when selectedUser == null]; Selected financial year was not found. [when financialYear == null]

ai_agent_guidance.use_when: When the user wants to update data
